accepted.sentence: In naval reconnaissance, quiet underwater craft can observe opposing fleets while remaining difficult to detect from the surface.
During blockades, some military underwater vessels have carried essential supplies into ports that surface ships could not safely reach.
Research crews use these craft to deploy instruments that record deep-ocean currents where surface-based measurements provide little detail.
Specialized vessels inspect submerged pipelines for damage, helping operators locate leaks before they disrupt offshore production.
Naval planners may use underwater patrols to monitor maritime approaches and provide warning of approaching hostile forces.
Crews can place scientific sensors on the seafloor, returning later to retrieve records of earthquakes or other activity.
Underwater craft give researchers access to deep habitats, where direct observation can reveal how organisms respond to extreme pressure.
In military exercises, crews practice evading detection, helping evaluate tactics for surviving in waters monitored by opposing forces.
